lines.beaver: 올해 결산 자료 다 나왔어요? 같이 볼까요?
lines.beaver_en: Are this year's closing figures ready? Shall we look together?
lines.beaver_roman: olhae gyeolsan jaryo da nawasseoyo? gachi bolkkayo?
lines.en: Yes, I've finished the financial report.

lines.beaver_en: How did the overall balance turn out?
lines.en: Despite the recession, we came out in the black.

lines.beaver_en: Impressive, given the recession. What about profit?
lines.learner: 이윤은 작년보다 조금 줄었어요. 거래가 줄었거든요.
lines.en: Profit dropped a bit from last year. Our deals decreased.
lines.roman: iyuneun jangnyeonboda jogeum jureosseoyo. georaega jureotgeodeunyo.

lines.learner: 기금 운용으로 자산이 늘어서 손실을 메웠어요.
lines.en: Fund management grew our assets and covered the losses.
lines.roman: gigeum unyongeuro jasani neureoseo sonsireul mewosseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그런데 회계 쪽에서 걱정하는 부분은 없어요?
lines.beaver_en: By the way, is accounting worried about anything?
lines.beaver_roman: geureonde hoegye jjogeseo geokjeonghaneun bubuneun eopseoyo?
lines.learner: 담보로 잡힌 자산이 많다는 지적이 있어요.
lines.en: It's been pointed out that many assets are pledged as collateral.
lines.roman: damboro japin jasani mantaneun jijeogi isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 아, 그건 좀 신경 써야겠네요. 대책은요?
lines.beaver_en: Ah, we should watch that. Any plan?
lines.beaver_roman: a, geugeon jom singyeong sseoyagenneyo. daechaegeunyo?
lines.learner: 담보 비율을 적정 수준으로 낮추려고 해요.
lines.en: We plan to lower the collateral ratio to a proper level.
lines.roman: dambo biyureul jeokjeong sujuneuro natchuryeogo haeyo.

lines.beaver: 경제 상황은 앞으로 어떨 것 같아요?
lines.beaver_en: How do you think the economy will go?
lines.beaver_roman: gyeongje sanghwangeun apeuro eotteol geot gatayo?
lines.learner: 불황이 내년까지 계속될 거라는 전망이 있어요.
lines.en: The forecast is that the recession will last into next year.
lines.roman: bulhwangi naenyeonkkaji gyesokdoel georaneun jeonmangi isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then what's the plan for next year?
lines.learner: 호황이 올 때까지 이윤보다 자산을 지키려고 해요.
lines.en: Until a boom comes, we'll protect assets over profit.
lines.roman: hohwangi ol ttaekkaji iyunboda jasaneul jikiryeogo haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good idea. Will we keep managing the fund?
lines.learner: 네, 기금은 안전한 곳에만 운용하는 게 좋겠어요.
lines.en: Yes, we'd better invest the fund only in safe places.
lines.roman: ne, gigeumeun anjeonhan goseman unyonghaneun ge jokesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Nicely organized. We can report it as is.
lines.learner: 고마워요. 그럼 회계팀에 결산 보고서 넘길게요.
lines.en: Thanks. Then I'll send the closing report to accounting.
lines.roman: gomawoyo. geureom hoegyetime gyeolsan bogoseo neomgilgeyo.
